title: Topic 19: Health & Body - Vocabulary
description: Core words for health & body: body, head, arm, leg, hand, foot, sick, headache, pharmacy, medicine. 8 tap exercises with embedded grammar.
canDoStatement: Say what hurts, name body parts, manage a pharmacy visit
introductionText:
body = ALL of you!  |  head = eyes, hair - the top!
arm = shoulder to hand  |  leg = it walks!
hand = five fingers  |  foot = it is in your shoe
(two = FEET!)
sick = not OK, not well  |  headache = your head is
bad - ouch!
pharmacy = the medicine shop  |  medicine = you take
it when you are sick
+ phrase bank: I have a headache. | I can't go to
work. | Go to bed!

vocabularyBlocks.title: Health & Body words
exampleSentences: I can't go to work today.
Is there a pharmacy near here?

grammarBlocks.title: HAVE/HAS for symptoms (I have a headache - extends T4's have
grammarBlocks.explanation: HAVE/HAS for symptoms (I have a headache - extends T4's have for features) + CAN'T (the negative of G11: I can't go to work) + imperatives for advice (G12: Drink water! Go to bed! + first light use of Don't..., now that do-support is known from T16)
patterns: have/has + a + symptom (I have a headache /
can't + verb (I can't come to class)

questions.question: Your ___ is in your shoe. Your ___ has five fingers.
You are not OK today - hot head, tired body. You are ___.
Tap the missing word: The medicine shop is the ___.
Tap the missing word: I have a headache. I take my ___ with water.
Which one is NOT a part of the body?
A: I am sick... I have a headache. B: ___
options: Go to bed and sleep! And drink water
questions.correctAnswer: Go to bed and sleep! And drink water

questions.question: Grammar: I ___ a headache. My brother ___ a headache too - what a day!
Grammar: I am sick, so I ___ go to work today. But I ___ watch films at home!

explanations.A1-T19-VOC-Q2: Sick = not well. (I am sick - like I am tired, T5!)
explanations.A1-T19-VOC-Q4: Medicine = you take it when you are sick.
explanations.A1-T19-VOC-Q5: A jacket (T18) goes ON the body - it is clothes!
explanations.A1-T19-VOC-Q6: A sick friend -> give advice with imperatives (T12 grammar, new job!).
explanations.A1-T19-VOC-Q7: I HAVE, he HAS - same rule as T4 (long hair), new use (headache!).
explanations.A1-T19-VOC-Q8: can't = can NOT. Sick -> can't work... but CAN rest!
